_meta.description: Core classes RENAMED/MOVED to a new fully-qualified name at a major version, where the fix is a pure 1:1 FQN substitution safe to auto-rewrite (use-statements, ::class, catch/type-hint/new references, and string-literal registrations in elgg-plugin.php). Consumed by the data-driven AST-ish rules under ElggMigrate\Rules\* via Rules\Shared\DataDrivenClassRenames. Because the keys are fully-qualified and unique, a plain substring replace is safe (no short-name collisions). Per-major (not cumulative).
_meta.excluded: Class REMOVALS with no 1:1 replacement, and API/signature changes that accompany a rename (e.g. Elgg 7 elgg_register_notification_event() array $actions -> string $action) stay LLM-guided — a blind rename cannot fix a changed signature.
_meta.relationship: Sibling to removed-function-renames.json (functions) — same data-driven-rewrite model, different symbol kind.
